column1: # Vellum partition table — D1001 (32 MiB QSPI flash)
# The D1001 carries a Winbond W25Q256 (256 Mbit / 32 MiB) external flash. Keep
# the small system partitions and ota_0 start aligned with the E-Series layout
# then use the additional capacity for two 8 MiB OTA slots and persistent FAT
# storage. Existing devices keep working with their previously flashed table;
# adopting these larger partitions requires a one-time factory/USB flash because
# an app-only OTA never rewrites the partition table.
